summary.oneLiner: The deck positions GE Vernova T&D India Limited (formerly GE T&D India Limited) as a disciplined-execution power transmission & distribution equipment player spanning power transformers, switchgear (GIS & AIS), grid system integration and grid automation, working a 209.3 BINR order backlog that is 77% private-sector and increasingly export-linked through GE Vernova group entities.
